_comment: The Well of Lost Dreams shape: an optional {X} payment made while a trigger resolves, X announced up to a printed ceiling, and the paid X read back.

cards.oracle_text: Whenever you gain life, you may pay {X}, where X is less than or equal to the amount of life you gained. If you do, draw X cards.
